summary: Always use {{ }} except in conditionals (when, failed_when, changed_when), which are already templated; moustaches don't nest, so build dynamic names with hostvars or the vars lookup, and check keyword templating with ansible-doc -t keyword.
questions: How do I reference a variable whose name is built from another variable?
How do I know if a keyword supports templating?

answer_card.title: When to use {{ }} and dynamic var names
answer_card.answer_md:
- Use `{{ }}` everywhere **except** `when`, `failed_when`, `changed_when` (already Jinja expressions).
- Templates don't nest. Instead of `{{ somevar_{{ other_var }} }}`:

```jinja
{{ lookup('vars', 'somevar_' ~ other_var) }}
{{ hostvars[inventory_hostname]['somevar_' ~ other_var] }}
```

- `ansible-doc -t keyword <name>` shows whether a keyword is `explicit` (needs `{{ }}`), `implicit` or `static`.
